page.overview:
What is Nomad?

A Nomad was a starship that arrived at systems just after a battle that damaged repair facilities to compensate for this and aid citizens of the affected systems. It had a repair bay large enough to handle multiple vessels.

The Nomad in the graphic novel adaptation appears to have been modeled after a Star Galleon-class frigate, a ship first appearing in the Legends novel The Last Command.
